ir.name: gap_threshold_no_float_002
ir.intuition: Build pairwise preferences only for clear wins: for each batch element, create (winner, loser) pairs when the lower-is-better objective of the winner is at least `gap_threshold` smaller than the loser's objective, filtering near-ties.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # Read threshold without using Python float(); keep as a plain value for meta.
    gap_threshold = extra.get('gap_threshold', 0) if extra is not None else 0

    # Pair (winner, loser) when winner objective is smaller by at least gap_threshold.
    # objective: [B, K]
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]
    mask = diff < (-gap_threshold)
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Ensure int64 1D tensors.
    b_idx = b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long).view(-1)
    winner_idx = winner_idx.to(dtype=torch.long).view(-1)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.to(dtype=torch.long).view(-1)

    meta = {'builder': 'gap_threshold', 'gap_threshold': gap_threshold}
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta=meta)
